is_gmc_policy.value: Yes, CAN MEDICLAIM (Group Health Insurance Scheme)

room_rent_percentage.value: No separate cap (Special Conditions clause 1.2 overrides standard 1% of Sum Insured per day)

icu_percentage.value: No separate cap (Special Conditions clause 1.2 overrides standard 2% of Sum Insured per day)

pre_hospitalization_days.value: 30 days (expenses payable without cap per Special Conditions clause 1.3)

post_hospitalization_days.value: 60 days (expenses payable without cap per Special Conditions clause 1.3)

nine_month_waiting_period.value: Applied (9 months waiting period; relaxed only in case of delivery, miscarriage or abortion induced by accident or other medical emergency)

baby_day_one_cover.value: Covered up to a maximum period of 90 days from date of birth, subject to combined maternity and baby care limit of 5% of sum insured

normal_delivery_metro.value: 5% of Sum Insured (document does not distinguish metro/non-metro or normal/C-section)

normal_delivery_non_metro.value: 5% of Sum Insured (document does not distinguish metro/non-metro or normal/C-section)

c_section_metro.value: 5% of Sum Insured (document does not distinguish metro/non-metro or normal/C-section)

c_section_non_metro.value: 5% of Sum Insured (document does not distinguish metro/non-metro or normal/C-section)

thirty_day_waiting_period.value: 30 days (does not apply if covered continuously for preceding 12 months; Special Conditions note states 2-year waiting period read as 1 year)

first_second_year_waiting_period.value: Not applicable (Special Conditions clause 4.3 overrides standard 24-month specific disease waiting period)

pre_existing_disease_waiting_period.value: 36 months (Special Conditions clause 2.30 & 4.1 override standard 48 months)

day_care_expenses.value: Covered for 35 specific day care procedures undertaken under general or local anaesthesia in less than 24 hours

opd_benefit.value: Excluded (Procedures/treatments usually done in out patient department are not payable)

domiciliary_hospitalization.value: Excluded (Special Conditions clause 2.11 states there is no Domiciliary Hospitalization cover available under this policy)

annual_health_checkup.value: Reimbursement of cost of medical check up once at end of every 3 underwriting years provided no claims reported, up to 1% of average sum insured during block of 4 claim free underwriting years

modern_treatment.value: Excluded (Unproven or experimental treatment excluded per Clause 4.18 / 4.14)

bariatric_treatment.value: Excluded (Obesity treatment and its complications including morbid obesity excluded under Clause 4.9)

psychiatric_treatment.value: Excluded (Treatment relating to all psychiatric and psychosomatic disorders excluded under Clause 4.9)

ayush_treatment.value: Ayurvedic Treatment covered only when undergone in Government Hospital or Institute recognised by Government and/or accredited by QCI/NABH; other alternative treatments excluded

organ_donor_expenses.value: Covered (Hospitalisation expenses excluding cost of organ incurred on donor in respect of organ transplant to the insured under Clause 1.2 E)

infertility_treatment.value: Excluded (Clause 4.9 specifically excludes treatment relating to infertility and sterility)

ambulance_charges.value: Maximum of Rs. 1,000 per policy period (part of total sum insured)

disease_wise_capping.value: No capping / restrictions not applicable (Special Conditions clause 1.2.1 overrides standard restrictions on cataract, hernia, hysterectomy, and major surgeries)

waiver_conditions.value: Clause 4.3 (24-month specific disease waiting period) waived/not applicable for this policy; 30-day initial waiting period waived if covered for continuous preceding 12 months; 9-month maternity waiting period may be relaxed for delivery/miscarriage/abortion induced by accident or emergency
